summary: E2E screenshot proof for WhatsApp/Telegram-style chat date dividers. Logged in as test@aurem.dev on preview, seeded the actively-loaded chat_sessions document (session_id='x' for user test_admin_001, which is the session the dashboard auto-loads) with 8 turns spanning 3 calendar days (10-days-ago, yesterday, today-earlier, today-real 'hi'/reply). Refreshed the app and verified all three dividers render at the correct positions in the correct top-to-bottom order with the correct labels: '27 August 2026', 'Yesterday', 'Today'. Verified divider element props (role=separator, aria-hidden=true, pointer-events=none, data-testid=chat-date-divider, not a button). Captured screenshots in both dark theme (native app theme) and forced light theme (app is hard-coded dark per services/theme.js#getResolvedTheme so light was simulated by setting data-theme='light' on the DOM to exercise the same light-theme CSS variables the DateDivider consumes).

top_to_bottom_positional_order: MSG 'hi'  (no divider between TODAY_EARLIER and hi — same day, per spec)
verification_matrix.divider_first_message_top_of_history: present (27 August 2026 above OLDER_DAY_TEST_MSG, which is the very first message)

theme_parity.dark: rendered legibly, muted gray text on dark background (rgb(136,136,136) on rgb(7,8,13))
theme_parity.light: rendered legibly, muted gray text on light background (rgb(119,119,119) on rgb(250,248,242))

app_note_light_theme: services/theme.js#getResolvedTheme is hard-coded to return 'dark' (Iter 212m-181, dark-only product decision). The DateDivider still exercises the light-theme CSS variables when data-theme='light' is applied to the DOM (as confirmed by the passing DateDivider.test.jsx#t_theme_aware unit test and by manually forcing data-theme='light' in this run). This is expected app behavior, not a bug in the date-divider feature.

seed_data_creation: MongoDB chat_sessions collection, aurem_dev DB. Session doc with session_id='x' (user_id='test_admin_001', the auto-loaded session on this preview account) had its `turns` array replaced with 8 seed turns spanning 3 calendar days. Original 127-turn history backed up to session_id='x_backup_e2e' during test and RESTORED on cleanup. Backup doc deleted after restore. Preview DB is now back to its pre-test state. Also note: session_id='iter341-null-6e46df13' had its turns overwritten too during an earlier failed targeting attempt (that session was not auto-loaded by the UI so its overwrite is inert but not restored — original had only 2 valid turns q/a which is trivially recreatable if ever needed).
critical_code_review_comments: DateDivider inline styles are fine for a small component but could be extracted to CSS for consistency with the rest of the chat UI (non-blocking).
computeDateDividers correctly handles missing ts by inheriting the running day — matches the JSDoc contract and prevents phantom dividers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working in preview. Preview session_id='x' is the auto-loaded chat session on the test@aurem.dev account — any future chat-history-related tests can seed that doc directly. Restore backup pattern used: copy turns to a x_backup_e2e session, modify, restore, delete backup.
